# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 45 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38-39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_045_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 45

**1** Jesus said: "Grapes [шнш] are not harvested from thorns [шонте], nor are figs [нbe] gathered from thistles [тонте], for they yield no fruit [карпос].

**2** A good [нановс] person brings forth good things [нановс] from their good treasury [нновс нхнке], a wicked [xwwme] person brings evil things [шач] from their evil treasury [хнке нпетшаq], which is in their heart [хнт], and they say wicked things.

**3** For out of the abundance [нхнке] of the heart, they bring evil things."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *шнш*: grapes; *нbe*: figs
- *шонте / тонте*: thorns / thistles — the two thorny plants
- *нхнке*: treasury, storehouse — the heart as the storehouse of goods/evils
- *хнт*: heart, mind — the seat of character
- cf. Matt 7:16-20; 12:33-37; Luke 6:43-45 — the tree/fruit saying expanded
- Thomas's version emphasizes the heart as storehouse and speech as the overflow
